lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid; the highest concentration of defined local maxima occurs in the mid-flank region posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a rectilinear pattern of nodes across the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A singular dominant horizontal feature on the upper third of the visible flank exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient, with high-luminance values along the superior edge transitioning to low-luminance values along the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Discrete high-luminance blobs are distributed across the first dorsal fin's silhouette, with higher density observed towards the leading edge and base relative to the posterior margin.
